title: etwdump: capture bluetooth HCI events on Windows
description:
This adds another provider to `etwdump` for `Microsoft-Windows-BTH-BTHPORT` which allows to capture natively bluetooth HCI events on Windows.
This is very similar to https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/drivers/bluetooth/testing-btp-tools-btvs, so this should workaround the deprecation of `TCP@` (see https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/work_items/21232#note_3691449069)

Demo:

![Screenshot_2026-08-16_183732](/uploads/84d52688bc2a754a16dc5731bb2fdcb2/Screenshot_2026-08-16_183732.png){width=900 height=540}

If possible, I would be interested in editing https://wiki.wireshark.org/CaptureSetup/Bluetooth if I can get granted access. Thanks

notes.body: changed title from etwdump: add bluetooth HCI events (BTH-BTHPORT) to etwdump: capture bluetooth HCI events on Windows

changes_data.diff:
@@ -254,6 +254,7 @@ an alias for the protocol and all its fields.
   * un-encrypted LDAP messages
   * un-encrypted SMB client/server messages
   * un-encrypted HTTPS messages (from both WinInet and WinHTTP)
+  * raw HCI events (similar to Microsoft's btvs.exe)
 
 * `etwdump` now supports capture options and has a much better support of
   undecipherable messages.

etwdump: add bluetooth HCI events (BTH-BTHPORT)

This adds a provider to etwdump for Microsoft-Windows-BTH-BTHPORT which
allows to capture HCI events on Windows. This was implemented by
Microsoft externally in 'btvs.exe', but is now native.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/drivers/bluetooth/testing-btp-tools-btvs
